data.name: Witness Sickness
data.detailed_description:
Witness Sickness is a multiplayer social deduction horror game for 4–8 players set aboard a failing space station.

One or more players are infected. The rest of the crew must complete cooperative tasks, watch each other carefully, and figure out who can still be trusted.

But the infection does more than hide.

SICKNESS SAYS

Throughout the match, the station is interrupted by sudden commands.

SICKNESS SAYS: FREEZE.
SICKNESS SAYS: FIND SOMEONE.
SICKNESS SAYS: STAY AWAY.

If the command is real, you must obey.

But not every command comes from the Sickness.

Fake orders can appear with a different prefix. Following one is a mistake.

Breaking the rules damages the station, so every player has to react quickly while also deciding whether the command itself can be trusted.

TRUST NO ONE

Players have different roles and information.

The infected can spread the sickness while trying to remain unnoticed.

The Witness can detect traces left behind by infection and use that information to identify suspicious players.

The rest of the crew must survive, complete their tasks, and decide who is lying.

WORK TOGETHER

Tasks across the station require cooperation between multiple players.

While everyone is busy repairing systems and completing objectives, the infected gets opportunities to isolate victims, manipulate the group, and create suspicion.

DISCUSS. SUSPECT. VOTE.

Watch how people behave during commands.

Who froze too late?

Who followed a fake order?

Who keeps disappearing with other players?

Use what you see, talk with the crew, and vote before the infection takes control.

Obey the Sickness.
But only when the Sickness actually speaks.

data.short_description: Witness Sickness is a 4–8 player social deduction horror game. Complete cooperative tasks, watch the crew, obey real Sickness commands, ignore fake orders, and find the infected before the station falls apart.
